The Department of Energy's mission is to ensure America's security and prosperity by addressing its energy, environmental and nuclear challenges through transformative science and technology solutions.

The Office of Energy Dominance Financing is committed to financing American energy and manufacturing projects that meaningfully contribute to U.S. energy security, grid reliability, and lowering costs for all Americans.

We are truly honored that DOE has been named America's #1 Best Employer for Veterans in 2023 by Forbes-not only among Government agencies, but among employers across the U.S. We are so proud of this ranking which reflects our commitment to the employment of veterans.

As so many veterans at DOE renew their service to our Nation, we are deeply committed to their success and advancement. Veterans shape the future of energy As an IT Program Manager, you will: Lead all major IT projects, set work priorities, and design the layout and setup of databases and systems.

Serve as the primary liaison to the DOE Chief Information Officer (CIO) to formulate cyber policy and act as the Authorizing Official (AO) for management information systems. Align IT security priorities with the Department's cybersecurity strategy, manage technical safeguards, and oversee vulnerability remediation plans.

Lead the Change Control Board and serve as the Program Records Official to ensure software interoperability, compliance, and records integration. Oversee the IT budget, serve as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and represent the division on federal IT acquisition reform (FITARA) requirements.

Perform the full range of first-line supervisory duties to lead and develop federal staff.
You must meet both the Basic Requirement and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this series as described below. BASIC REQUIREMENT: Applicants must have IT-related education and experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below at a proficiency level equivalent to the next lower grade level in federal service.

Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-14 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting ALL of the following: Managing and disseminating information to stakeholders while serving as a senior IT official. Providing administrative and policy direction to the organizational elements reporting to the Office of the Chief Information Officer.

Managing computer facilities, equipment, and telecommunications network. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience. Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Limit your resume to no more than two (2) pages.

If more than two pages are submitted, only the first two pages will be reviewed to determine your eligibility and qualifications. Your full resume will be made available to the hiring manager if you are referred.

Time-in-Grade: Current Federal employees must meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement to receive consideration and current employees must have at least a fully successful or equivalent performance rating to receive consideration.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

This position may be filled using Direct Hire Authority: Z5CAV/Direct-Hire Authority (Certain DoD Personnel) PL 118-31, Sec 125OB (i)(2), 12/22/2023.This position is being filled under the memorandum from the Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness (USD(P&R)) "Expansion of Direct Hire Authority for Certain Personnel of the Department of Defense," dated August 12,2024.

As a PROGRAM MANAGER (ACQUISITIONS) at the GS-0340-14 some of your typical work assignments may include: Lead the design, development, and continuous enhancement of automated tools, digital platforms, and applications tailored to streamline acquisition, financial management, and program management workflows.

Partner directly with contracting officers, program managers, and financial teams to analyze daily business operations, identify process bottlenecks, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions.

Design and implement data analytics, reporting dashboards, and key performance metrics to evaluate acquisition effectiveness, track program health, and provide actionable, data-driven insights to senior leadership.

Develop and conduct targeted, desk-side training and user-adoption workshops to empower the acquisition workforce to effectively utilize new digital tools, centralized platforms, and data repositories.

Evaluate the effectiveness of deployed acquisition systems and tools, capturing user feedback and lessons learned to drive iterative enhancements and optimize the agency's overarching acquisition strategy.
You may qualify at the GS-14, if you fulfill the following qualifications: A.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service as listed below: Analyzing federal acquisition processes (such as contracting, financial execution, or program management) to identify operational bottlenecks and translate business needs into technical requirements.

Designing or developing centralized data tools, digital platforms, or automated workflows that streamline and enhance acquisition, financial, or program management operations.

Developing data-driven performance metrics, reporting dashboards, or analytical tracking systems to evaluate acquisition effectiveness, monitor program health, and guide strategic leadership decisions.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

In this position you will serve as a first line supervisor over a team of Program Managers who are engaged in managing critical program segments for which the scope and effect of the work have an Office of Field Operations-wide impact.

You will oversee a variety of law enforcement programs, to include enforcement operations for drug interdiction and seized narcotics accountability. This position starts at a salary of $143,913.00 (GS-14, Step 1) to $187,093.00 (GS-14, Step 10).

Typical duties include: Planning, organizing, coordinating, controlling, and evaluating the activities of an organization(s) Overseeing the overall planning, direction, and timely execution of a program or several program segments, each of which is managed through separate subordinate organizational units Leading complex projects, often cutting across organizational/activity lines, defining critical quality factors and process improvements Assuring implementation by subordinate organizations and operating units of the goals and objectives of a CBP-wide program Determining goals and objectives that need additional emphasis; developing measures that evaluate performance; making recommendations for program improvement; and managing all resources as corporate assets GS Salary: Visit this link to view the locality pay tables by geographic area.

If you do not see your geographic area listed, select the "Rest of United States" pay table. Some positions fall under a special pay rate depending on the series, grade level and location of the position. Please visit this link to view special pay rate charts.
Experience: You qualify for the GS-14 grade level if you possess 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Planning, directing, and evaluating major program segments that include diverse professional, technical, and administrative activities, with impact across a headquarters-level office or nationwide program, including development and execution of multi-year work plans and goals.

Leading complex, cross-organizational projects as a subject matter expert, including applying analytical methodologies (such as statistical tools, mathematical techniques, and process mapping) to improve service delivery, reduce costs, increase quality, and develop and justify business cases.

Providing technical direction in project management, team building, facilitation, process improvement analysis, and the methodology required to develop and substantiate a business case for the selected project.

Overseeing law enforcement-related programs such as inspection, intelligence analysis, drug interdiction, and seized property accountability, including ensuring enforcement of applicable laws and policies, overseeing enforcement actions, and ensuring proper custody, preservation, and disposition of contraband and seized property.

Managing organizational change and resources, including approving allocation and distribution of funds, implementing internal controls in accordance with the Federal Managers' Integrity Act, identifying and resolving issues where no policy exists, and coordinating with senior officials within and outside the agency to address complex, cross-cutting program issues.

NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You must: Meet all qualification requirements, including education if applicable to this position, subject to verification at any stage of the application process; and Meet all applicable Time in Grade requirements (current federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade or equivalent grade band in the federal service) by 08/12/2026.

The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees.

If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C, Non-career SES or Presidential Appointee employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the Human Resources Office. Background Investigation: U.S.

Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is a federal law enforcement agency that requires all applicants to undergo a thorough background investigation prior to employment in order to promote the agency's core values of vigilance, service to country, and integrity.

During the screening and/or background investigation process, you will be asked questions regarding any felony criminal convictions or current felony charges, the use of illegal drugs (e.g., marijuana, cocaine, heroin, LSD, methamphetamines, ecstasy), and the use of non-prescribed controlled substances including any experimentation, possession, sale, receipt, manufacture, cultivation, production, transfer, shipping, trafficking, or distribution of controlled substances.

For additional information on the preemployment process, review the following link: Applicant Resources | CBP Careers Residency: There is a residency requirement for all applicants not currently employed by CBP.

Individuals are required to have physically resided in the United States or its protectorates (as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.

If you do not meet the residency requirement and you have been physically located in a foreign location for more than two of the last five years, you may request an exception to determine if you are eligible for a residency waiver by meeting one or more of the following conditions: Working for the U.S.

Government as a federal civilian or as a member of the military A dependent who was authorized to accompany a federal civilian or member of the military who was working for the U.S. government Participation in a study abroad program sponsored by a U.S. affiliated college or university Working as a contractor, intern, consultant or volunteer supporting the U.S. government Probationary Period: All employees new to the federal government must serve a one year probationary period during the first year of his/her initial permanent federal appointment to determine fitness for continued employment.

Current and former federal employees may be required to serve or complete a probationary period. Agency Career Transition Assistance Program (CTAP) Eligibles: If you have never worked for the federal government, you are not CTAP eligible. View information about CTAP eligibility on OPM's Career Transition Resources website.

You must submit the supporting documents listed under the Required Documents section of this announcement.

Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Durchführung von komplexen Rockwell PharmaSuite MES-Projekten – von der Planung bis zum Go-Live. Dabei leitest du Projekte und stellst die termingerechte, budgetkonforme Umsetzung im Einklang mit den Kundenanforderungen und Qualitätsstandards sicher.

Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT ). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States.

In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states.

Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business.

Are you ready to change the world with us? ABOUT THE ROLE The HV & Commissioning Project Manager represents the Owner (IPP) and leads all high-voltage (HV), protection & controls (P&C), SCADA/communications, testing, and commissioning activities for utility-scale solar and energy storage assets.

This role owns cost, schedule, scope, quality, and risk for the HV build and commissioning phases from pre-functional checks through energization, interconnection testing, COD, and turnover to Operations.

Functions as the primary interface with utilities, Owner’s engineers, EPCs, testing/commissioning vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring systems are safe, compliant, utility-approved, and reliable for long-term operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO Own end-to-end HV and site wide commissioning project planning and control, establishing the WBS, baseline schedule, cash flow forecasts, procurement milestones, and resource plans. Drive weekly schedule reviews, recovery planning, and critical path management with EPC and site leadership.

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.
Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met.

Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.
As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.
What you'll own
Onboarding projects
Build and own the project plan for each new laboratory, from kickoff to go-live, with dependencies and dates kept current.
Direct the work across our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and the customer's staff.
Accompany the validations customers run as part of onboarding. The laboratory's medical director designs the study; you make sure the technical setup is correctly installed and working, that our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and that the customer has everything they need to complete it.
Carry the committed go-live date, and raise risks early with options rather than after a slip.
Customer success after go-live
Act as the customer's main point of contact once live, monitoring usage and engagement and reaching out proactively.
Own incoming support requests: resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop with the customer.
Bring what you learn from customers into product planning, and flag potential expansion opportunities to Sales where relevant.Bring what you learn from customers into product planning.
You do not carry a sales target. But flagging expansion opportunities to Sales is part of your responsibility.

Bei Ypsomed entwickeln wir innovative Medizintechniklösungen, die Menschen mit chronischen Erkrankungen weltweit ein selbstbestimmtes Leben ermöglichen. Unsere Mitarbeitenden arbeiten in interdisziplinären Teams, übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten mit modernster Technologie die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen. Wir fördern eine offene, inklusive Unternehmenskultur, in der Vielfalt geschätzt wird, neue Perspektiven willkommen sind und sinnstiftende Arbeit im Mittelpunkt steht.
In dieser spannenden Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Produktion und Werkzeugbau verbindest du die Arbeit direkt am Spritzgusswerkzeug mit analytischen und koordinativen Tätigkeiten. Du analysierst und optimierst Spritzgusswerkzeuge, treibst Verbesserungen voran und koordinierst Projekte mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

Ypsomed – Selbstbehandlung wird zur Selbstverständlichkeit
Ypsomed ist führende Entwicklerin und Herstellerin von Injektionssystemen für die Selbstverabreichung flüssiger Medikamente. Seit über 40 Jahren ist das Unternehmen eine verlässliche Partnerin der Pharma\- und Biotechbranche – mit Lösungen, die genau auf die Bedürfnisse ihrer Kunden zugeschnitten sind.

Ypsomed verfügt über eine ausgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz und bietet das umfassendste und innovativste Plattformportfolio für Pens, Autoinjektoren und On\-Body\-Devices. Die Lösungen überzeugen durch höchste Umsetzungsqualität und lassen sich nahtlos in digitale Gesundheitsangebote integrieren.

Sie unterstützen eine einfachere Therapie und tragen so zu mehr Lebensqualität für Menschen mit chronischen Erkrankungen bei.
Ypsomed hat ihren Hauptsitz in Burgdorf (Schweiz) und betreibt ein globales Netzwerk von Produktionsstandorten. Über 2 000 Mitarbeitende weltweit engagieren sich täglich dafür, die Selbstbehandlung zur Selbstverständlichkeit werden zu lassen.

For our **Artwork Design** team, we are looking for an experienced professional to join us as
**Artwork Management & Change Control Manager (100%) (m/f/d)**
In this role, you will support the efficient and compliant execution of **Artwork Management and related Change Control processes** across our network. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external artwork design partners, you will help ensure reliable end-to-end processes, adherence to agreed service levels and alignment with global best practices.
As a key and administrative user of the **Global Artwork Management System (GLAMS)**, you will provide operational system expertise and support effective ways of working across the stakeholder network. As part of an evolving organization, you will also contribute to defining, implementing and continuously improving Artwork Management and Change Control processes.
You will report directly to the **Head of Artwork Management and Change Control**.

* Drive the efficient and reliable execution of Artwork Management processes, ensuring effective end-to-end interfaces and collaboration across internal stakeholders and external artwork design partners.
* Act as a key and administrative user of the Global Artwork Management System (GLAMS), supporting effective system use and related processes across the relevant stakeholder network.
* Support the definition, implementation and continuous improvement of Artwork Management and Change Control processes, contributing to lean, efficient and scalable ways of working.
* Collaborate closely with external artwork design partners and internal stakeholders to support timely and compliant execution and adherence to agreed service levels.
* Support and influence stakeholders involved in artwork creation and maintenance to ensure adherence to established processes and global best practices.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of a lean Change Control process, working across functions to enable efficient execution.
* Support artwork development for new product launches and coordinate relevant activities with internal and external stakeholders.
* Contribute to process-efficiency and continuous-improvement initiatives across Artwork Design and related Change Control activities.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Design, Packaging, Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in Artwork Management, Artwork Coordination, Design, Labelling, Supply Chain or a related function.
* Experience with process definition, implementation and/or continuous improvement is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of Artwork Management processes and systems; experience with GLAMS or a comparable Artwork Management System is highly desirable.
* Experience working with external design partners, agencies, vendors or other service providers is an advantage.
* Experience in the pharmaceutical or another regulated industry is advantageous but not required.
* Green Belt, Lean, Operational Excellence or equivalent certification is an advantage.
* Fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.
* Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and priorities.
* Strong communication, collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with external partners.
* High degree of flexibility, curiosity and self-learning capability, with the ability to quickly build expertise in new systems and processes.
* Comfortable working in an evolving environment, where processes and responsibilities continue to develop.
**About this position**
* You will join an evolving team and work at the interface of **Artwork Management, Change Control, systems and process improvement**. The position offers a high degree of cross-functional interaction and requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders as well as external artwork design partners.
* As the organization and its processes continue to develop, you will have the opportunity to contribute your experience to the definition and improvement of ways of working rather than simply executing established processes. Your ability to learn independently, adapt to changing requirements and build effective relationships across the organization will therefore be important to your success.
Interested in this opportunity? We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV, employment references and degree certificates.
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas.

We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.
CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

* PME industrielle suisse en pleine évolution
* Un rôle clé au sein du comité de direction
## About Our Client ##
Notre client est une PME industrielle suisse spécialisée dans la fabrication de composants de haute précision pour des secteurs exigeants tels que l'aéronautique, le médical, l'horlogerie et l'automobile. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'évolution de ses processus, l'entreprise souhaite renforcer son équipe de direction avec un Responsable Qualité capable de faire évoluer durablement son système qualité.
## Job Description ##
**Vos responsabilités en tant que :**
* Piloter et faire évoluer le système de management de la qualité.
* Garantir la conformité aux normes ISO 9001 et EN/AS 9100.
* Structurer les processus qualité et renforcer leur intégration dans les opérations.
* Développer une culture d'amélioration continue auprès des équipes.
* Piloter les audits internes, clients et de certification.
* Suivre les indicateurs qualité, les non-conformités et les actions correctives.
* Collaborer étroitement avec la Production, les Méthodes et la R&D.
* Garantir les moyens et procédures de contrôle nécessaires à la conformité des produits.
* Accompagner l'évolution du système qualité dans le cadre de la migration vers un nouvel ERP.
* Participer aux projets liés aux futures certifications, notamment ISO 14001.
* Manager et développer une équipe de 6 personnes.
* Participer aux décisions stratégiques en tant que membre du comité de direction.
## The Successful Applicant ##
Le profil idéal du Manager Qualité
* 8 ans d'expérience minimum en qualité dans un environnement industriel.
* Expérience confirmée dans la mise en place, la structuration ou l'amélioration d'un système qualité.
* Très bonne maîtrise des normes ISO 9001 et EN/AS 9100.
* Une expérience dans l'aéronautique est fortement privilégiée ; une expérience dans le médical est également très appréciée.
* Bonne compréhension des environnements de production et des problématiques techniques industrielles.
* Anglais B2 minimum.
**Ce qui fera la différence**
Nous recherchons une personne pragmatique, autonome et capable de challenger l'existant.
Vous savez appliquer les normes avec rigueur tout en gardant une approche proche du terrain et des réalités industrielles. Votre capacité à fédérer les équipes et à faire évoluer les pratiques sera essentielle.
## What's on Offer ##
* Un rôle stratégique au comité de direction.
* Le management d'une équipe de 6 personnes.
* Un environnement industriel de haute précision.
* Une forte exposition aux secteurs aéronautique et médical.
* Un réel périmètre d'action pour faire évoluer le système qualité.
* Une entreprise familiale en croissance, avec une vision à long terme.

Über BERNMOBIL
BERNMOBIL ist in der Stadt und Region Bern ein stark verwurzeltes Unternehmen mit modernsten Fahrzeugen und vielfältigen Berufen. Unsere roten Trams und Busse gehören zur Stadt Bern wie die Aare oder der Zytglogge. Mehr als 1000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bewegen in der Region Bern jährlich über 100 Millionen Fahrgäste.

Damit gehört BERNMOBIL zu den grösseren Transportunternehmen in der Schweiz. Trotz der Grösse und der Reichweite von BERNMOBIL sind wir auf unsere familiäre Atmosphäre und bieten eine Kultur, bei der sich alle Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter auf Augenhöhe begegnen.

Die Diversität unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sowie unserer Berufe ist von grossem Wert und besonders hervorzuheben. Wir fahren nicht nur Tram und Bus. Wir halten auch unsere Fahrzeuge in Stand oder planen und bauen grosse Teile unserer Infrastruktur selbst. Ausserdem betreiben wir die Geschäftsstelle des Libero\-Tarifverbundes.

Mit unseren neuen Trams und den Elektrobussen leisten wir zudem einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Umwelt. Ohne Wenn und Aber: Arbeiten bei BERNMOBIL lohnt sich auf jeden Fall.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, planning, coordination, implementation, execution and management of one to many medium projects, several large projects, and/or complex projects according to pre-determined scope, schedule and budgets. Senior Project Managers will also provide coaching and mentoring to less experienced Project Managers / Project Coordinators. It is expected that the majority of time (70%) will be in customer facing activities.
What you'll be doing
Partners with business leaders to deliver services that support company objectives and that are consistent with Winning Together values.
Lead the planning and implementation of project(s) throughout the project lifecycle, initiation through closure.
Oversee the review of project scope, goals and deliverables both internally and externally.
Oversee and Develop a project task list (tracker), risk/issue/action, project contacts and a full-scale project plan as required within Computacenter United States Inc’s approved applications and systems.
Assemble and coordinate project resources both internally, externally and with 3rd parties.
Manage project budget, resource allocation, project plan, project trackers and project timelines as required.
Track and advise on project deliverables and tasks using appropriate applications, systems, and/or tools.
Own and resolve any issues that arise during the project and drive risk mitigation.
Drive team accountability for project results of staying on-budget, on-schedule, and maintain client satisfaction.
Communicate with internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to project scope, tasks, deliverables, goals, resources, schedules and budgets.
Communicate expectations to stakeholders and team, gaining acceptance and accomplishing customers business objectives.
Identify resources required to fulfill project delivery, collaborating with other Project Managers, the Resource Management Group and other groups as required to determine which project resources are available in order to schedule project workload and make assignments.
The Senior PM should work with the Resource Management Group to explore ways to drive efficiencies on third party project delivery.
Oversee all products and corresponding issues (software licensing, shipment logistics, DOA's, late or changed shipment dates) are coordinated with customer and Computacenter United States Inc Sales and Engineering teams.
Provide status reporting throughout the project to internal and external stakeholders on progress against project schedule, and any issues and their accompanying mitigations.
Quickly escalate to next level of management and/or senior management any project related issues/risks that will impact the project negatively.
Ensure all project team timecards, expense reports, status reports, issue documentation, project tracker(s), project plan(s) and project documentation are entered and/or updated into the Computacenter United States Inc applications & systems in a timely fashion, verifying accuracy and completeness.
Obtain client sign-off on the Project Completion Form.
Perform invoicing and project closure functions including sending and following up on Customer Satisfaction Survey’s.
Senior PM’s will be called upon to mentor those around them in aspects of leadership, methodology, tools, people skills, and navigating difficult customer environments.
Senior PM’s will be called upon to conduct mid project checks as well, as after action meetings for continual improvement.
Senior PM’s will be expected to have the ability to turn around any sized project that may not be performing up to Computacenter United States Inc’s high-quality expectations.
Embrace and support Computacenter ’s mission and core values.

Experience with Salesforce is a plus.
Legally eligible to work in the United States.
Expert knowledge of both theoretical and practical aspects of project management.
Expert knowledge of project management techniques and tools.
Direct work experience in project management capacity.
Proven ability to motivate and build strong teams.
Experience coaching and mentoring.
Excellent customer interfacing skills.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
Proven experience in effective meeting facilitation.
Proven experience in people management.
Proven experience in issue & risk management.
Proven ability to multi-task, stay organized, and work efficiently.
Proven ability to work independently, as well as with peers.
Proven ability to problem solve and perform analysis.
Proficient in project management software.
Strong knowledge of technical concepts, terms and practices used in the assessment and implementation of IT Infrastructure and Services.
Supervises, directs and controls the activities of assigned staff.
Interviews, schedules, trains and assigns work.
Establishes performance expectations and monitors results.
Develop and nurture a team to highlight strengths and raise the bar for talent.
Ensures a trained, motivated and professional staff capable of providing efficient and effective operations and exceptional member service.
Recommends the discipline and/or discharge of staff, while maintaining required personnel documentation.
Coaches and counsels staff, as necessary.
What you can expect
There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. # Manager:in digitale Kanäle 80 - 100% #
Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis
### Unser Angebot ###
* Eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem motivierten Team
* Gelebte flache Hierarchien und flexible Home-Office-Regelungen
* Spannende Einblicke in die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten unserer Einheiten
* Ein Arbeitsort direkt am Hauptbahnhof
* Die Stelle ist in Lohnklasse 20 eingereiht (Informationen zum Lohnsystem).
### Bewerbung ###
Schick uns deine Bewerbung direkt über unser Online-Tool (für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen). Bei Fragen zur Stelle kannst du dich gerne an Samuel Klaus, Leiter Recht Digital, wenden (043 259 25 43, samuel.klaus@ji.zh.ch).

MCD is seeking an outstanding IT Program Manager (PM) to join a team of mission-focused leaders who identify and develop integrated capabilities on behalf of the Counterintelligence and Security community.

This position provides oversight for system budget, scope, and timelines, and leads coordination with IC elements, DCSA, PAC PMO, and other executive branch stakeholders to modernize personnel security data sharing, improve reciprocity, and reduce friction in clearance and transfer-of-trust processes.

Ensure alignment of ToRIS initiatives with NCSC strategic priorities, Trusted Workforce 2.0 objectives, and IC-wide personnel security modernization goals. Lead interagency collaboration to drive consensus and mission outcomes across the IC, DoD, DCSA, PAC PMO, and executive agency stakeholders.

Guide the strategic evolution of ToRIS capabilities, including personnel security data sharing, reciprocity workflows, IC PERSEC Passport development, personnel vetting questionnaire integration, and related modernization efforts.

Manage expectations of senior-level customers and ensure delivery of quality products and services supporting enterprise personnel security operations. Negotiate interagency agreements for data and information sharing to enhance system integration, reciprocity, and mission effectiveness.

Coordinate with legal, privacy, civil liberties, and policy stakeholders to ensure ToRIS capabilities comply with applicable authorities and governance requirements.
